notes: WP REST API, all 690 posts since 2026-01-01. Included: tag Watch Releases 2026, or category Watch Releases, or title Debut/New Release, or category Hands-On (excluding titles with Review/Long-Term/Second Look and two accessories), plus 19 hand-picked untagged Sponsored posts presenting a specific watch. Excluded: podcasts, giveaways, ICYMI round-ups, Top 10 lists, events, editorials, untagged Wrist Time Reviews, other sponsored posts. Caveats: items tagged Watch Releases 2026 include some Wrist Time Reviews; untagged Hands-On items are assumed 2026 launches but a few may be older watches; some sponsored picks may predate 2026. Refs only regex-extracted from REST article content (690 > 600 so pages not fetched separately), so low coverage and may contain noise; brand and model left empty (no structured field).
